description: This file defines a class 'NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler' that implements the 'IStreamFailureHandler' interface. The class provides no-op implementations for handling stream delivery and subscription failures, effectively ignoring such failures.

classes.name: NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler
classes.description: A class that implements 'IStreamFailureHandler' with no-op methods for failure handling, optionally configurable to fault on error.

methods.name: NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler, optionally setting it to fault on error.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles delivery failure events; in this implementation, it does nothing and returns a completed task.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Handles subscription failure events; in this implementation, it does nothing and returns a completed task.
